scope: Existing acquired tables only; no external schedule extrapolation, no OD or money model
C01_sync_unsync: Use the same physical leg set and same physical departure IDs. Coordination is an experiment transformation, not an additional service or free resource.
null: Empty CSV field with explicit missing_reason/status; absence of retained record does not prove absence of service
operating_vs_marketing: Publisher carrier label/prefix is separate evidence. Legal operating carrier and marketing carrier are separate nullable fields; labels do not resolve code-share relationships.
nonstop: Endpoint offer is not a nonstop leg. Adjacent listed stations in full routing are labelled PUBLISHED_ADJACENT_STATIONS, not verified nonstop.
timezones: Versioned source IANA plus inherited validation. Conflict remains NULL. No timezone from neighbouring/candidate airport to bypass quarantine.
dates: No year imputation for SVX rules; no assignment of OMS weekday to remote-origin departure; arrival day offset unknown unless explicit or exact date supplied.
acceptance: Published rule, dated departure, full calendar compatibility, airport identity, operating identity and execution are independent acceptance axes.
frozen_consumption: Consumers pin input_set_id AND output commit plus output manifest SHA. Later product evidence requires a new input set. Raw/source acquisition and scenario constants remain separate.
return_night_basis: 7/10/14 LOCAL HOTEL nights; hotel-arrival date after ground transfer/check-in, not outbound departure date. Unknown hotel/transfer clock blocks night compatibility; no implied return date from departure date.
history: v1.0 was a pre-publication draft; v1.1 clarifies hotel-night basis before any output release.
